title: People’s Mañanera November 18
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**“Everyone wants to know about Mexico; this is a very special moment for our
country”  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum presented Plan Mexico as the keynote speaker at
Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, with well-being at the center
of her remarks. “We’re making great progress,” Sheinbaum said regarding trade
negotiations with U.S. President Donald Trump, adding that they will meet
again at the G20 meeting.

**Sheinbaum Strengthens Talleres Gráficos to Produce Ballots for the INE and
the OPLEs  
** In 2024, 19 of the 32 Local Public Electoral Bodies (OPLE) contracted
private companies to print their ballots for next year’s elections. The new
decree makes the contracts public, provides for audits by the Federal Superior
Audit Office, and adds the National Polytechnic Institute (IPN), the National
Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), and the Tec of Monterrey to the Board.
The President appointed Viridiana Gabriela Yáñez Rivas as director of Talleres
Gráficos. The Ministry of the Interior explained that a ballot of equal
quality can cost three or four times more from one state to another, so it
proposes standardizing prices, reusing ballot boxes, and creating the Imprenta
Nacional printshop.

**Mexico Proposes Immigration Summit and Cooperation for Development in
Countries of Origin  
** In the presence of U.S. Ambassador Ronald Johnson, Interior Ministry Rosa
Icela Rodríguez reported a 96% drop in migration flows and stated that none of
the 24 caravans that have been organized have reached the country’s northern
border.
